note: Every tool the CLI wraps: lib/wrap.mjs starts the row's script, passes its output back and maps its exit code; the CLI adds no logic. A row's script and test are tracked files; its summary, usage, args, flags, exits, output and example are its help. engines lists commands/*.mjs, the commands whose logic lives in the CLI. Checked by test/registry.mjs.

site sign.summary: Sign a clean site build into a new folder as a draft, live or handed-over copy
site sign.args: none; folders are absolute paths (the CLI runs the script from the repository root); tools/site-sign/README.md

draft.help: sign this clean build as a draft preview (needs --host)

live.help: sign this clean build for go-live (needs --client, --date and --host; the owner's go)

handover.help: sign this clean build as handed over (needs --client and --date)

out.help: the new folder (it must not exist)

host.help: the one address Omnikom publishes it at

client.help: the client's name as on the site (live, handover)

register.help: the register file, kept outside the repository (or set SIGN_SITE_REGISTER; one is required)

exits.0: signed, its own check passed, one register line added

site sign.output: signed <stage>: <ID>; the counts; check PASS; register line added (a refusal is one REFUSED line on stderr)

site check.summary: Check a signed build against its clean build for its stage (needs no register)
site check.args: none; folders are absolute paths (the CLI runs the script from the repository root)

clean.help: the clean build it was signed from

exits.1: CHECK FAIL, one line per problem

site check.output: CHECK PASS (<stage>): <n> files, signature <ID>, or CHECK FAIL and one line per problem

site seal.summary: Seal a signed draft: each page becomes an encrypted block shown only on our host
site seal.args: none; folders are absolute paths (the CLI runs the script from the repository root)

in.help: the signed draft folder (its <in>-functions beside it)

out.help: the new folder (it and <out>-functions must not exist)

register.help: the register file, kept outside the repository (or set SIGN_SITE_REGISTER; one is required)

exits.0: sealed, its own check passed, one register line added

site seal.output: sealed draft: <ID>; the counts; check PASS; register line added (the key is never printed)

site seal-check.summary: Check a sealed draft against its signed draft: each block opens to that page, nothing else ships
site seal-check.args: none; folders are absolute paths (the CLI runs the script from the repository root)

in.help: the signed draft it was sealed from

exits.1: SEAL CHECK FAIL, one line per problem

site seal-check.output: SEAL CHECK PASS: <n> pages, signature <ID>, or SEAL CHECK FAIL and one line per problem

site deploy.summary: Upload a signed or sealed build to its Pages project after its checks; fill its register line
site deploy.usage: omnikom site deploy <folder> --clean <clean> --mode draft|sealed|live|handover --to preview|production [--i-mean-production] --project <pages project> [--in <signed draft>] [--functions <lead.js>] [--register <file>]
site deploy.args: <folder>: the signed folder, or with --mode sealed the sealed one; folders are absolute paths

clean.help: the clean build it was signed from

mode.help: draft, sealed, live or handover (live and handover: the owner's go only)

to.help: required, no default: preview for draft and sealed, production for live and handover

i-mean-production.help: required with --to production: the owner's go for a live or handover upload

in.help: with --mode sealed: the signed draft it was sealed from

functions.help: a lead form function, deployed as functions/api/lead.js

register.help: the register file, kept outside the repository (or set SIGN_SITE_REGISTER; one is required)

exits.1: refused (REFUSED: <why>; nothing deployed), --to production without --i-mean-production, or CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN not set
exits.2: wrong command line (a mode with another --to included)

site deploy.example: omnikom site deploy /work/demo-site/sealed --in /work/demo-site/draft --clean /work/demo-site/clean --mode sealed --to preview --project demo-site-preview --register /work/register.tsv
